slides.headline:
Sent the quote.
Then *nothing*.
slides.sub:
What your CRM should do with
the quotes nobody's replied to.

slides.title:
Give every quote
a status
steps: A quick call or email, noted on the job.

slides.title:
When to
*chase*
items: Check it arrived and ask if anything's unclear.
Offer to talk it through or change the spec.
Ask if it's still going ahead, then close it off.

slides.title:
Where do
your open
quotes live?
instead: You only remember them when the customer rings.
try: One list, oldest at the top
Each with a reminder date and a name next to it.

slides.text:
A no with a reason
is worth *keeping*.
slides.sub: After a few months you'll see whether it's price, timing or something else losing you work.
